00

HIIIII HAHAHAHAHA 😭

THIS IS AYANGGG!!! 😭😭

If you're reading this, congratulations! HAHAHAHAHA nakaabot ka diri. 😭 BASAHA TANAN HA. Ayaw pag-skip-skip kay basin naa kay ma-miss. And please, WAY MAG-CRY OYYY. 😭 Ayaw pud pag-inarte diha HAHAHAHA.

Actually, wala pud ko kabalo nganong gihimo nako ni HAHAHAHA. Maybe kay mas sayon para nako isulat kaysa isulti tanan nimo face-to-face. Kay if magstorya ta, basin makalimot ko sa uban, basin ma-emotional ko, or basin mag-away na pud ta before nako maingon tanan.

So yeah… here I am, finally writing down the things nga dugay na nako gusto isulti nimo.
01

THE THINGS I NEVER SAID

There’s no day nga dili ta mag-away about small things. And honestly, kapoy na siya, boiboi.

Sometimes I act okay after an argument, pero deep inside, naa gihapon koy things nga wala nako nasulti.

I stopped for a while because I realized nga dili nako gusto nga ing-ani pirmi atong relationship. I needed space to breathe and think about what I really feel.
02

I SEE YOUR CHANGES

I want you to know nga I see your changes. I notice them, and I appreciate them. I really do.

Pero if I’m being honest, naa gihapon gamay nga something nga murag off. Not because I don’t see your effort, but because some things that happened before still affect me.

I’m not expecting you to fix everything overnight. I just want you to understand why sometimes I’m still hurt even when things are getting better.
03

“NEVER TAKA MURAHON”

I still remember when you told me, “never taka murahon.”

Mao siguro nga sakit kaayo para nako whenever bad words come out during our arguments. I know I have my own mistakes too. I know sometimes ako pud ang makasugod or makapadako sa away.

But I always wished nga bisan angry ta, dili nato kinahanglan mag-ingon ug words nga makasakit sa usag usa. Especially because you know nga softhearted ko.

Some words disappear after the argument, but the feeling they leave behind can stay.
04

MY CONFIDENCE

There were moments nga instead nga ma-feel nako nga you help me become more confident, some words made me feel smaller instead.

And honestly, I’m still trying to find that confidence again.

I’m not writing this to blame you. I’m writing this because I want you to know what happened inside me whenever those moments happened.
05

WHAT I REALLY WANT

I don’t want a perfect relationship. I know we’ll still have disagreements. We’re both still learning.

But I want us to learn how to communicate without hurting each other. I want us to be able to say, “I’m angry,” without making the other person feel unwanted.

I want respect even during arguments. I want us to listen. I want us to fix things instead of making the same wounds deeper.
06

BEFORE YOU CLOSE THIS

I love you, and that’s why I’m saying these things instead of keeping everything inside.

I appreciate the changes I see in you. I appreciate the effort. But I also hope you understand that healing from old hurt takes time.

I’m not asking for perfection. I’m asking for consistency, patience, and a relationship where both of us feel safe enough to be honest.
♡

Before You Go…

I don't want a perfect relationship.
I just want a relationship where even when we fight,
we don't forget that we love each other.

I see your changes. I appreciate them.
I just hope we learn how to choose each other better.

Love, Ayang 🤍
made with all the things Ayang couldn't say out loud ♡
